EXPLAIN SELECT
    p.order_key,
    p.label,
    sum(d.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM agg_sub_preserved AS p
JOIN agg_sub_detail AS d
  ON d.order_key = p.order_key
WHERE p.order_key IN (
    SELECT order_key
    FROM agg_sub_detail
    GROUP BY order_key
    HAVING sum(quantity) > 100.00
)
GROUP BY p.order_key, p.label
ORDER BY p.order_key;

EXPLAIN SELECT c_count, count(*) AS customer_distribution
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_key, count(o.order_key) AS c_count
    FROM singleton_customer AS c
    LEFT JOIN singleton_orders_large AS o
      ON c.customer_key = o.customer_key
     AND o.comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'
    GROUP BY c.customer_key
) AS counts
GROUP BY c_count
ORDER BY c_count;
